messages:
chloe: Noticed a cluster of tenants where invoice-preview token totals are ~30% lower than final invoices across the last 3 hours. pattern: low preview, higher ledger. anyone seen sampling changes today?
ryan: We rolled out a sampling-weight tweak to the per-route sampler at 03:00 UTC to smooth preview noise for free-tier. It changed default sampling_weight for route=embed-heavy -> 0.1 from 0.25.
taylor: That should reduce preview counts, not increase ledger. Could this be a consumer mismatch where preview applies sampling but ledger doesn't (or vice versa)?
chloe: Logs show preview_consumer is marking events as sampled=true and scaling up estimated tokens by 1/sampling_weight. However the ledger ingester seems to ignore sampling metadata and ingest raw events then normalize at the end, different math.
anna: Small correction: it's "anna" here. I dug into a tenant's raw events. Example event exported from edge: ```{"tenant_id":"t-123","route":"embed-heavy","model":"embed-v1","tokens":1024,"sampled":true,"sampling_weight":0.1,"sample_reason":"preview-smoothing"}``` Preview consumer multiplies tokens*10 for UI. Ledger expects `sampled` only for telemetry, but uses aggregate counters computed from full stream after enrichment.
aylor: (typo: taylor) If ledger ingester sees the sampled event plus also receives the non-sampled companion (we emit both sampled AND unsampled for certain debug modes), ledger will double count. Are we emitting duplicate events for the same request id?
ryan: We added debug emit under a feature flag for canary tenants; shouldn't affect prod. But a bug in clientlib-v2 header meant some tenants got the flag enabled.
chloe: Great, so root cause hypothesis: misplaced debug flag -> preview shows scaled estimates (correct for sampled stream), ledger receives both sampled and raw leading to higher invoice.
taylor: Quick mitigation: stop emitting duplicate unsampled events for any tenant without explicit debug header. I can push a hotfix to clientlib to gate that.
anna: For schema changes: we should add `sampling_seed` and `sample_reason` to the metering event so dedupe/ledger can deterministically detect sampled vs unsampled pairs and drop the unsampled when paired. That avoids heavy rollbacks.
ryan: Agree on `sampling_seed` (string) and `sample_reason` (enum). Also add `sampled` boolean if not present; make additions optional to stay non-breaking.
aylor: Also propose we standardize preview math: preview_consumer should prefer unsampled canonical events when available, otherwise scale sampled events. That preserves UI fidelity.
chloe: Action items: 1) taylor -> hotfix clientlib gate to stop duplicate emits (15m). 2) ryan -> proto change for sampling_seed + sample_reason + sampled (non-breaking) (2h). 3) anna -> preview_consumer change to prefer canonical unsampled events, fallback to scale sampled (1h). 4) chloe -> alert that fires if preview/invoice delta > 15% per tenant over 30m. 5) ops-bot -> create incident/inc note.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2099 created: "Sampling-weight rollout caused preview/ledger divergence" assigned to @taylor and @ryan. Link: https://redwood.example/inc/2099
billing-bot: BillingOps notified. Playbook link: https://redwood.example/playbooks/billing-sampling-runbook
ryan: I'll draft the proto PR and include compatibility tests for older consumers so adding fields is safe. Will post PR link here when ready.
taylor: Hotfix pushed to clientlib-v2 (PR: https://git.redwood/clientlib/PR-7721) - rolling to canaries now.
anna: Preview consumer patch open: https://git.redwood/preview/PR-4190 - adds logic to prefer unsampled events. Tests added.
chloe: I'll enable the preview/invoice delta alert and monitor. If we still see divergence after hotfix+consumer patch, we rollback the sampling-weight change.
ryan: Thanks everyone. Also let's update Console: show a small indicator in route analytics when sampled data is being used and a link to sampling documentation so support won't get swamped.
taylor: Will add a short blurb for the console and ping UX for quick copy approval.
chloe: Closing loop: aim to have hotfix + consumer patch live within 2 hours; proto change merged within 6. keep updates here. :eyes:
